verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own card authorization controls let you define rules on how and where issued cards can be used, applied automatically at each card authorization; this is a narrow, product-native form of rule-on-event action. The spend overview also mentions automating company spend, but without detail, and webhooks only push event notifications, making them a developer building block that earns no credit. Missing for 10: a general user-definable event-to-action rules or workflow engine, rules beyond card-spend restrictions (e.g., auto-transfers or auto-conversions on events), detailed docs on rule configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
